rationale: Fubon Financial's insurance subsidiaries adopted IFRS 17 from 2026-01-01 and the official 2026Q1 report retrospectively restated 2025Q1. The same report also retrospectively adjusts EPS for a 2025-10-01 capitalization from capital surplus. The original 2025Q1 filing reports basic EPS of 3.00, while the 2026Q1 comparative column reports a loss per share of 2.09 after the accounting-basis and share-basis restatements. Existing 2025Q2, Q3, and annual EPS facts remain from the pre-IFRS-17 reporting basis, so they cannot be combined with the restated 2025Q1 and 2026Q1 facts to produce a current-comparable TTM EPS or PE.

Page 3-1 states that insurance subsidiaries adopted IFRS 17 from 2026-01-01 and retrospectively restated 2025Q1; page 5 reports consolidated EPS of 2.40 and comparative loss per share of 2.09; page 103 confirms 14,007,365 thousand weighted-average shares and a separate 2025-10-01 capitalization adjustment from comparative loss per share 2.15 to 2.09.

observations.description: The official auditor emphasis paragraph states that insurance subsidiaries adopted IFRS 17 from 2026-01-01 and retrospectively restated the 2025Q1 consolidated financial statements.
The original 2025Q1 filing reports basic EPS of 3.00, while the 2026Q1 comparative column reports a loss per share of 2.09; a share-count adjustment alone cannot explain the sign change.

The official EPS note identifies a 2025-10-01 capitalization from capital surplus, uses 14,007,365 thousand weighted-average shares for both presented Q1 periods, and changes the already IFRS-17-restated comparative loss per share from 2.15 before the share adjustment to 2.09 after it.

The available 2026Q1 filing supplies a restated 2025Q1 comparative, but no same-basis restated 2025Q2 discrete/YTD, Q3 discrete/YTD, or annual EPS facts. Pre-transition 2025 filings therefore remain as-reported evidence only and cannot form a current-comparable TTM series.
